## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:ADR-0130 D2(两处)、其 Non-goals 与备选 5、ADR-0141 的 Unchanged 行,各加一条带日期的 ⚠️ 指向,点名 2026-11-12 对 ADR-0019 D3 的修订与 `958734cbac`,原裁决句一字不删;设计文档 `marketplace-publishing.md` 与公开文档页 `audience-based-interfaces.mdx` 的「套件折叠成一个应用」句改写为修订后的规则。
- 为什么改:ADR-0019 D3 已按「改成 Salesforce 模式」修订(一个套件可呈现多个应用,每个应用由不同包定义,应用包至多一个应用),但 ADR-0130/0141 仍写「D1–D3 原文不变」,设计文档与文档页仍教「一个应用、永不套件」;人或 AI 搜 D3 会落到旧读法。
- 风险与回滚:纯文档,4 个文件 +88/−20,不动代码、schema、技能;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`docs/adr/0130-release-artifact-as-co-ownership-boundary.md` D2 下两条指向(:211、:235);`docs/design/marketplace-publishing.md` §6 新增的 Shape C 与改写的「Not allowed」框;`content/docs/ui/audience-based-interfaces.mdx` 第 22 行。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main -- docs/adr/`,预期只见新增的 ⚠️ 指向行,无任何删除行。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`docs/adr/**`):请批准或合并。

## What changes

Four files, +88 / −20. The amended rule is quoted, not paraphrased, from ADR-0019 D3's amendment note on `main` (`ba35dfd7`): "A suite (one install: an app package plus the module packages it composes) MAY surface more than one app, provided each app is defined by a different package of the suite, and an app package defines at most one app."

- **`docs/adr/0130-release-artifact-as-co-ownership-boundary.md`** (+26 / −0, no ruled sentence touched).
  - D2, after "D1–D3 stand verbatim and unamended": a dated pointer naming the amendment, #32585 and `958734cbac`, quoting the rule, and saying D1 and D2 are not amended; of "installs, opens, uninstalls" only "opens" reads differently (ADR-0019's note under D1).
  - D2, after the ⛔ line: a pointer quoting ADR-0019's own "Records that restate D3" note: the line "stands as drawn", "What ADR-0130 calls a suite is a container a consumer browses or installs, and that stays removed", and the "exactly one consumer-visible consequence" "gains a second: a module the app package brought may surface an app of its own."
  - Non-goals, "Not a suite": a pointer saying which "suite" the line excludes, since the amended D3 uses the word for one install of an app package with its modules.
  - Alternative 5, "ADR-0019 D3 by another name": a pointer saying the fold is reversed and the rejection stands on what the amendment keeps: D1, D2, and a suite "is no second consumer unit. It has no listing and no package type of its own."
- **`docs/adr/0141-inter-app-dependency-declared-checked-before-install.md`** (+8 / −0): a pointer after the **Unchanged** line, whose consumer-model item is kept as the reading of 2026-10-25.
- **`docs/design/marketplace-publishing.md`** (+53 / −19): a new dated `Updated:` header line (the 2026-05-31 line kept); §1's HotCRM paragraph rewritten from "being refolded into a single consumer App" to the suite it ships as (hotcrm `main` at `ac4dd3d`: sales in the app package, service and marketing in their module packages); §2.1's taxonomy line; §6's lead rewritten to the amended rule, "(recommended for HotCRM)" dropped from Shape A, a new **6.3 Shape C** (a suite through `composeStacks(..., { manifest: 'preserve' })`), and the "Not allowed" box rewritten to one package surfacing N apps plus a suite as a second consumer unit, naming `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION` for `type: app` and `type: module`; Summary item 5.
- **`content/docs/ui/audience-based-interfaces.mdx`** (+1 / −1): "More audiences therefore never mean more apps" becomes per package, a `type: 'module'` package is held to one app too (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts#SINGLE_APP_PACKAGE_TYPES`, `app` and `module`), and a suite may surface more than one app, each defined by a different package. The "See also" line ("one app per package") still holds and is unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- **Nothing already landed.** Commits on each file since `958734cbac` (GitHub REST, `commits?path=`): ADR-0130's last is PR #32846 (`2d52e297d3`), which dated only the §1.5 `validateSingleApp` row; ADR-0141's last is #31415 (2026-11-08); the design doc's last is #18838 (2026-09-17); the docs page's last is #29447 (2026-11-02). None carries these pointers.
- **Left as written, still true:** ADR-0130's TL;DR "does not move a single letter (D2)" (its D2 now carries the pointer) and References "(unamended by this record)"; ADR-0141 D6 "ADR-0019 keeps its text verbatim" and its Cross-references line (both describe ADR-0141's own act); ADR-0141 Context's "the standalone module is therefore an App in its own right" (the shelved cross-artifact consumer).
- **Same family, outside this card's surface, noted only:** the header comment of `packages/spec/src/kernel/package-registry.zod.ts` says "a consumer package defines at most one app — there is no 'suite contains apps' aggregator", and the design doc's §2.2 quotes it. Read per package it still holds (no package of a suite defines more than one app), so it is not a defect; a wording pass is the spec lane's to pick up.
- The design doc's Shape A example still uses HotCRM-style ids as an illustration; only its "recommended for HotCRM" heading was dropped.
